name: Twilio SendGrid

evidence.transactional: F02: Email API sends transactional and application email through the API or SMTP
evidence.newsletter: F02: Marketing Campaigns sends audience-based campaigns with contact management
evidence.marketing: F21: drip series start when contacts join a list or segment; trial access conflicts (F21)

line: Transactional email APIs and audience-based marketing campaigns.

cells.newsletters: Yes, with affirmative consent and unsubscribe controls
cells.api: Yes, REST API and SMTP relay

subs.math: 4,000 sends need the paid Basic plan. The exact 1K tier price is not published. Basic starts at $15 a month.
20,000 − 15,000 included = 5,000 extra emails × $0.0040 each = $20.00 in extra charges. The 5K base price is not published.
40,000 − 30,000 included = 10,000 extra emails × $0.0030 each = $30.00 overage. The 10K base price is not published.
200,000 − 150,000 included = 50,000 extra emails × $0.0028 each = $140.00 overage. The 50K base price is not published.

appmail.math: 3,000 emails fit inside the 50,000 included monthly sends. This is the paid starting price, before extras and tax.
10,000 emails fit inside the 50,000 included monthly sends. No overage.
50,000 emails use the 50,000 included monthly sends. No overage.
100,000 emails use the 100,000 included monthly sends. No overage.
